scope: Read-only runtime/contract design advice. No final architecture approval, readiness/QA/lifecycle verdict, implementation or executed test evidence.
baseline: OBS-001..005 closed; supplied OBS-005 reviewed digest b0761908eb0eaca411e75fc824dfaa382d9d90d556ee07b296ee19f9ae61ef57. This reconnaissance does not re-review or alter closed-story evidence.

recommendation.candidate: A closed declarative artifact-v2 observed-operation language/IR, deterministically lowered from the canonical exercised plan, with an explicit observed-2 validator/executor branch inside the ordinary admitted run/child/recording pipeline.
recommendation.why: This avoids adding a second model or a new hand-written source parser, preserves operation/locator/read/argument identities directly, and leaves artifact-v1 TypeScript AST and reference-policy-v2 semantics untouched. It is a candidate for architect selection, not a frozen new artifact schema.
recommendation.notEquivalent: Do not pass observed actions through legacy createPlaywrightAdapter defaults: its visible-only narrowing and textbox/searchbox/combobox fallback deliberately differ from observed exact locator correspondence. Do not reuse GuidedRuntime as ordinary replay: it owns guided session callbacks, initial authoring admission/fences and no-video browser launch rather than normal replay job/evidence ownership.

verifiedCurrentGaps.finding: Ordinary replay validates only artifact version1 with exact {version,steps} and per-step originalText/code. The TypeScript AST emits the legacy Operation union, which has no read or binding arguments. Reference-policy parser only accepts version2 variable/secret sets.

Observed contracts declare artifact2, referencePolicy3, lowering1, contract/learnedPlan/observation/guidedPolicy2 and language/executor observed-2. Ordinary constants remain artifact1, validator2.0.0, executor2.1.0 and syntaxReference2.1.0. A declared tuple is not ordinary replay support. No contracts/v2/revision.schema.json currently exists.

RunJob and JobEnvelope are closed and carry no observed scope/plan/provenance/compatibility package. Source-free IPC launch/execute is separately closed and its typed operations cannot carry reads/hidden bindings. All of these production boundaries need coordinated changes, not a fixture-only adapter.

The ordinary runner prelaunch compatibility check compares its recorded image pins to compiled-in runtime pins; it does not receive revision provenance in the job. Backend admission receives runtimeVersions, while backend readiness compares the persisted revision. An observed exact-tuple handshake must join these facts explicitly.

Current readiness requires confirmed_revision_id and write-once manual confirmation identity, re-derives authoring-v2 reference policy via IntentRevisionVerifier, and refuses artifact versions other than CompilePins.SUPPORTED_ARTIFACT_VERSION=1. Observed scoped-Run publication needs an explicit readiness/provenance branch, not fake manual confirmation or a captured-value token grammar.

The normal BrowserHandle already exposes createObservationSession on the same recorded page. The isolated collector/read/native-input primitives are reusable without creating a separate guided browser. launchGuidedBrowser intentionally starts an unrecorded standalone guided context and is the wrong replay evidence entry point.

Legacy parent redaction is initialized from resolved starting vars/secrets and can include page location/observed-host diagnostics. Fresh captured values never reach that parent, so those redactors cannot protect new runtime values. Observed replay needs data-free textual diagnostics from launch while preserving separately protected video/timeline evidence.

integrationChoices.mechanism: Artifact discriminator selects a bounded schema and cross-record validator. Canonical operation records preserve ordered source coordinates, actual origin/null bootstrap precondition, exact durable locator, operation/read recipe and opaque argument/binding IDs. Pure validation emits source-free typed observed operations plus immutable graph/input metadata. Runtime executes the trusted switch, never interprets code text.
benefits: Smallest semantic gap to the exercised plan and easiest independent operation-equivalence comparison.
No new executable source grammar, eval or source-token dependence.
Legacy AST, optional legacy policy and role-fallback semantics remain version-dispatched and unchanged.
costs: Need explicit v2 artifact/policy/job/IPC/result-version branches and observed runtime capabilities.

Existing code editor/manual code confirmation must not treat the data artifact as legacy Playwright code; a readable code view, if added later, is derived presentation rather than execution authority.
Per-step/source association still needs exact stable IDs/order for reporting and immutable source verification.

integrationChoices.choice: Deterministic restricted code artifact2 with a new read/binding DSL
integrationChoices.mechanism: Generate only fixed allowed statement forms with typed capture/binding access, parse those through a separately versioned AST path, and compare parsed semantic IR to the exercised plan. No JS declarations, arbitrary functions or page evaluation becomes legal.
benefits: Fits existing code display and AST-based validation architecture.
Can reuse some existing permitted-statement/reporting machinery.
costs: Adds grammar/reference-argument/parser work and more ways to lose exact origin/read/edge semantics.
Generated code still needs the same new trusted read/value runtime, strict adapter, IPC and policy3 guards; it does not avoid the integration work.
Exact escaping/Unicode and operation-equivalence validation are mandatory; no global widening of v1 allowed identifiers/locators.

integrationChoices.choice: Replay by resuming guided worker/session or another translator loop
integrationChoices.reason: Reject this shortcut. It conflates original admissions/fences/values with a new explicit run, does not preserve ordinary child recording/reporting/admission behavior and risks automatic model calls or re-execution after uncertainty.

deterministicLoweringContract: Assemble the learned plan from immutable stored proposals plus successful one-dispatch ledgers, accepted obligations/source choices, cumulative allocations, successful producer metadata and actual consumer edges. Verify each source step and requested assertion, every exact action coordinate/order and bidirectional graph coverage. Model proposals or semantic plan obligations alone are not executed evidence.

Preserve the exact executed locator with exact=true, operation kind, key/predicate, source-input identity, read recipe policyRuleId/classification/type, origin and edge slot/order. Preserve JSON null as the source origin for only the first blank-start navigation and an explicit initialContext precondition. Destination origin is never substituted for that null origin.

Lower a fixed canonical semantic projection of that plan to artifact bytes without model calls, browser calls or another submission. Independently decode/validate the produced artifact and compare its ordered semantic projection to the original trusted plan; hashing two copies generated by one faulty lowerer is not an independent equivalence check.

Keep canonical-v1 and the non-ASCII/combining-character vectors consistent in Java and Node. Choose artifact bytes deterministically so raw UTF-8 artifactHash, DB JSON rehash and runner identity agree. Do not change legacy ArtifactCanonicalizer semantics to accommodate a new path; validate the stricter v2 integer/Unicode/closed-key domain explicitly.

Derive reference policy3 from the verified learned-plan graph and recorded scoped Run/admission provenance. It must bind plan/provenance/source/configuration/operation identities and exact producer/consumer slots, not from English capture tokens or model-provided references. Validate both missing and extra/reassigned edges.

Stable authored nonsecret inputs retain exact server-validated source/configuration provenance and opaque input IDs. Deliberately authored literal bytes can be represented as authorized inputs; captured page samples cannot. Saved-variable/secret values remain per-run trusted resolution, never become captured binding initializers or persisted artifact samples.

Preserve the distinction between a database revision UUID used by current jobs/history and the observed cryptographic revision digest declared by the reserved original revision contract. Bind both explicitly in publication/admission; do not coerce a hash into a UUID or silently replace legacy ID semantics. Persistence mapping belongs to the architect/data review.

stableExecutableDefinition: Server-issued bindingId as a graph key.
Producer source coordinate, exact durable locator/read recipe and expected origin.
Ordered consumer coordinates and allowed argument slots/destination origins; explicit transfer-policy identity where supported.
Frozen source-input references, initial-context precondition, learned-plan hash and exact compatibility requirements.
immutableHistoricalEvidenceNotReplayAuth: Original producer/consumer admission IDs and guided session Run authorization remain publication provenance linked to the learned-plan/revision hash.
They are not the later run admission, do not prove a later read succeeded, and must not seed local availability or dispatch rights.
neverPersistAsReplayTargetsOrValues: Original nodeId/documentId/generation or pinned CDP/DOM handles.
Original worker/context/fence, availability receipts or local capture map.
Captured value, sample literal, value digest/length or caches from the guided run.
stableVersusExecutionLocal.freshReplay: Each explicit execution gets a new admitted execution/attempt identity, isolated browser/context, private masking inventory and empty value map. The same stable producer definition reads fresh bytes at its coordinate. Consumers require that run-local successful producer and exact graph edge. Missing/changed sources stop; no fallback to prior receipts, saved variables or previous-run values.

replayRuntimeSequence: Backend current readiness/authorization validates immutable revision, original plan/provenance hashes, unchanged source/configuration and current principal/CSI/account/application/policy grants. Original Run authorization is provenance, never reusable permission. A changed execution scope needs an explicit compatibility/relearning decision, not silent rebinding.

Create a fresh ordinary execution/attempt; authenticate dispatch and pass the declared observed tuple plus current scoped execution authority. Runner validates envelope/artifact/reference policy/hash identities before capacity/admission/browser launch. Backend admission compares the actually running observed tuple with immutable revision pins and grants this attempt once.

Launch through the existing confined recording child with observed mode/data-free diagnostics selected before browser creation. The child receives only validated typed operations/graph/input-reference metadata and authorized per-run inputs, never artifact/source/program text or original captured values. Current account setup uses the authorized same-context port; unavailable production account support remains fail-closed.

Verify actual initialContext. A blank-start artifact requires genuine fresh about:blank/null origin; configured auth setup that has navigated elsewhere cannot be labelled blank. Execute the first authored navigation once through the frozen destination input and current destination/redirect policy.

At each operation, use the private observed collector to establish current document/target identity for the frozen exact locator, with unique resolution and current scope/origin/type/actionability/read policy. Local ephemeral node identities may be created for correspondence, but never leave the worker or enter the artifact. Reuse retained-target native input behavior from the guided boundary; do not fall back to legacy role equivalence or visible-only locator reinterpretation.

For a read, positively authorize the frozen recipe against current configured field/region/application grant and source intent. Preserve exact nonblank valid Unicode bytes; apply count/per-value/aggregate limits and write the binding once in this run. Mask captured data locally. For each consumer, verify successful earlier local producer, allowed exact coordinate/slot and same-origin/current transfer policy before filling/asserting. No value may enter locator, destination, key or prohibited assertion slots.

After mutations collect fresh local evidence; bounded read-only stabilization may verify the same frozen target, never choose a replacement locator, invoke a model or repeat an uncertain mutation. On drift, target replacement, policy revocation, cancellation, timeout or lost context, stop and clear values. A deliberately initiated later guided relearn is a separate user action.

Report source-step timing and verdicts through the established run-clock/StepReporter/IPC path. Hidden reads must remain attributed to their source step and consumer actions to theirs. Flush recording/manifest through existing protected evidence workflow. Textual diagnostics remain bounded/data-free; video is explicitly a separate authorized disclosure. Preserve at-most-once run admission and no automatic effect retry.

productionSeams.requirements: Version dispatch to a strict pure v2 validator and policy3; legacy AST and reference rules remain unchanged. Add parser/language/arguments files only if the architect chooses the code-DSL alternative.

productionSeams.area: Backend browser-free validator and immutable readiness
productionSeams.requirements: Accept observed versioned validation verdict/pins and scoped-Run publication provenance without invoking either compiler/guided gateway or pretending manual confirmation. Keep legacy CompilePins behavior per lane, not a global artifact-version flip.

Wire real observed immutable revision identity, exact required tuple/current scope/policy/input materialization through closed job and admission contracts. No pre-resolved captured bindings in resolvedVars; dynamic values arise only in the child. Preserve dispatch CAS/cancellation/deadlines/evidence IDs.

Explicit typed observed execution branch with exhaustive child boundary checks; no source-shaped keys, new executable JS or parent-held dynamic values. Reuse step clock/reporting/confinement rather than creating a disconnected replay test runner.

Reuse private read, positive region grants, native input and exact correspondence primitives. Extract/share bounded value-map behavior if helpful; do not import guided orchestration/model callbacks into replay. Ordinary recorded browser needs actual approved-origin/redirect/read-policy installation and blank/page capability on its same page. Mounted trusted policy must be resolved for current app/scope, not supplied by the artifact itself.

Advertise/check exact observed tuple separately from legacy semver compatibility, plus actual Playwright/Chromium/image pins. observed-2 is not semver and must not be fed into a backwards-compatible-minor comparison or masquerade as the legacy executor.

Select data-free raw-output/error/host/location handling before launch for observed replay; parent redaction cannot know freshly captured values. Keep readable video, normal timeline origins and evidence cleanup. Mark guided learned-from-run evidence separately from later replay-verified execution identity; no phantom replay result at publication.

Add explicit artifact2/reference-policy3/revision publication and job/IPC compatibility contracts as the architect selects. Preserve old schemas/fixtures bytewise unless an approved versioned amendment says otherwise. Audit supported runtime schema keywords; standalone shared-checker acceptance is not proof the packaged runtime schema subset supports a new contract.

independentRuntimeEvidenceRequired: Start with a real guided execution that submits exactly once. Record independent session-bound server receipts and both gateway HTTP baselines. Complete/publish through the actual backend path; assert no new browser launch, no additional submit/operation receipt and zero calls to either gateway during finalization or duplicate finalize.

Execute the same immutable artifact via the actual ordinary run job, backend admission, child IPC, real Chromium and evidence reporting twice after publication. Fixture server issues a different unpredictable value per isolated run. Independent receipts must match each run producer value exactly, differ across guided/replay1/replay2, and retain identical artifact/learned-plan hashes. Assert zero legacy compiler-gateway and zero guided-gateway calls for both replays.

Exercise visibleText and permitted controlValue, exact whitespace/non-ASCII bytes, same-step multiple ordinals, fresh source state, retained binding use and final requested assertions. Verify timeline/recording maps to actual source/consumer steps and no values appear in parent IPC, raw output, logs, errors or manifests.

Mutate a published locator, operation, read recipe/policyRuleId, input provenance, binding producer, consumer slot/order/origin, original admission provenance, source/configuration or compatibility tuple. Independent validators/readiness/admission must refuse before inappropriate effects; recomputed client hashes cannot authorize altered stored provenance.

Real drift cases: duplicate/hidden locator twins, replacement between resolution and native invocation, sensitive type/ancestor/descendant change, revoked region grant, changed origin/redirect, absent earlier producer and changed initial-context precondition. No locator-role fallback, model repair or hidden navigation/read-back replay is allowed.

Cancellation/timeout/crash/lost acknowledgement and overlapping runs prove private value-map destruction/isolation, no reused producer receipt and no duplicate effects. Preserve all existing legacy validator/adapter/job/recording tests instead of redefining their expected behavior.
decisionsForArchitect: Select declarative IR versus restricted code DSL before allocating schema/AST work; both require a real observed executor and exact equivalence proof.
Freeze the observed artifact/input-reference/policy3/job/IPC tuple and distinguish storage UUID from cryptographic revision digest.
Choose the explicit readiness/publication discriminator that honors recorded scoped Run consent while leaving legacy manual confirmation unchanged.
Specify current account/read/egress policy installation in ordinary child launch and explicit replay initialContext support; production account adapter remains OBS-007.
Bound and report exact observed runtime diagnostics/evidence/version identity without letting old legacy redaction or fallback semantics weaken the lane.
constraints: No product/test/schema/story edits; no builds/browser execution or CLI/wave changes performed.
No final design approval or lifecycle verdict assigned.
No claim of production account readiness, live provider benchmark or human pilot.
Shared USD500 ceiling acknowledged; spend telemetry unavailable.
